verdict.rationale: Checkout.com's issuing product applies to this story: it can send authorization requests to the program owner for decisioning and supports accept/reject rules. However, the evidence never documents what context those authorization events carry. Merchant name, MCC, enhanced merchant data, wallet or entry-mode details, and partial-approval or incremental-auth signals are all unevidenced. 'Blocked industries' spend controls are only an adjacent feature and do not show MCC appearing in the event payload.

support.subject: As a developer, every authorization event carries decision-grade context — merchant name and MCC, enhanced merchant data, wallet and entry-mode details, partial-approval and incremental-auth signals
